// PROBE FIXTURE — not compiled, not rendered. It exists so
// tests/unit/always-dark-surfaces.test.ts can prove its detector still fires.
//
// This is the defect that shipped to production twice in PolicyHero: a surface
// hardcoded dark in BOTH themes, carrying classes and helpers that resolve to
// their LIGHT value in light mode — dark text on a near-black card.
import { getStatusColor } from "@/lib/policy-status"

export function AlwaysDarkProbe({ status }: { status: any }) {
    const c = getStatusColor(status)
    return (
        <section className="rounded-3xl bg-[#111111] p-6 text-white">
            <span className={`${c.bg} ${c.text} ${c.border}`}>status</span>
            <button className="pw-secondary-button">action</button>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">caption</p>
        </section>
    )
}
